name: Cobalt
description: Cobalt is a static site generator written in Rust that renders Markdown with Liquid templates.
notes: Posts are generated without front matter (Cobalt rejects the canonical keys); date and title come from the file name. firstRelease from the first cobalt-bin crate on crates.io (0.2.0, 2016-06-25); the oldest GitHub release is v0.4.0 (2017).
